name: side to side box shuffle
description: A quick-footed drill where you hop side to side over a box. It builds agility, lower leg stamina and conditioning.
instructions: Stand next to a low box or step on one side.
Place the foot closest to it on top.
Hop across, landing the other foot on the box as the first foot goes down.
Keep your steps light and quick.
Continue shuffling side to side at a steady pace.
